name: Titsuba Idean
source:
"That's all you've been talking about lately, Victorie."

A Wordsworth student who holds [url=/c87479]Victorie[/url] in high esteem, making the two good friends. She was orphaned from a young age, and harbors low self-worth and abandonment issues. She is unaccustomed to praise, making her easy to flatter.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=chitsuba]official page[/url]]
